five_second.sells: online art/drawing courses framed around meditation, 'manifesting' and neuroscience-flavored spirituality
five_second.for_whom: people wanting a mindful, spiritual creative hobby or a new coaching credential built around drawing
five_second.price_guess: somewhere in the $50-300 range for a course

features_used.moment: Found a real named founder, Anna Denning, with a bio mentioning a Hay House-published book co-authored with a named bestselling author, Colette Baron-Reid.
Opened the certified facilitators directory and found 28 named people with their own live websites, Instagram, Facebook and email addresses, real proof the school produces practitioners.
Had to scroll through a very long page of course content before the price finally appeared at the very bottom.

features_used.feature: flagship course page (AM Method Coaching Certification)
features_used.moment: Found clear tiered pricing (997/1497 GBP or 1397/1997 USD) with split-payment options, but realized this 'beta' program is a coaching certification aimed at practitioners, not a casual hobby class.
Opened the 'Are results guaranteed?' question and got only a no-guarantee disclaimer, nothing about refunds.
Found a real refund clause: a 14-day UK cooling-off period for digital purchases, waived once content is accessed, refund requests must be in writing.
Checked the homepage, the store page and multiple course pages and never found a single quoted student testimonial or star rating anywhere.

features_looked_for_but_missing: a refund policy stated on the course page itself instead of buried in general Terms
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: The Our Graduates directory of 28 named certified facilitators with real working websites and social accounts - harder to fake than any testimonial quote.
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: No testimonials anywhere on the site, and the flagship course is a four-figure 'beta' coaching certification aimed at therapists/coaches rather than the simple mindful hobby I came looking for.

friction.moment: Price on the Zendala course page only appeared after scrolling the entire page top to bottom.
Refund terms are not on any course page, only inside a long general Terms and Conditions page, and the right to cancel is waived once you access the content.
No testimonials or reviews from past students found anywhere on the site.

The main course promoted in the nav bar is a coaching certification for professionals, not a beginner hobby class, so it took real digging to find something that actually fits a retiree looking for a relaxing pastime.

delight.moment: Anna Denning's bio checked out as a real, verifiable person with a published Hay House book co-authored with a named bestselling author.
The graduates directory was far more convincing than expected - 28 real named facilitators each with their own live business, not a handful of stock-photo quotes.

what_earned_it: a real named founder with a verifiable book credential
a registered company name (Neuro Art School Ltd, England and Wales) named in the Terms
a large directory of named graduates with working personal websites and social links
a written refund/cooling-off clause in the Terms and Conditions
trust.what_it_would_take: Actual quoted testimonials or reviews from past students, and the refund terms stated plainly on the course page itself rather than buried in a general legal document.

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's an online art-and-manifesting school run by a real published author with dozens of named graduates you can actually look up, but the flagship coaching certification runs nearly a thousand pounds and felt built for therapists and coaches, not someone just wanting a relaxing hobby.
brand_recall.product_remembered: Art of Manifesting Method Coaching Certification
brand_recall.price_remembered: 997 pounds (or about 1497 for the mentored tier)
